exposure: Child with myelomeningocele who underwent intrauterine fetal surgery
outcome: Family dynamics (relationships with husband, family, and friends)
Child's special needs/adaptations (walking aids, bladder control)
cohort: The study included 11 mothers of children who had undergone intrauterine myelomeningocele repair.
finding: The majority of mothers reported excellent relationships with their husband, family, and friends, and approximately 64% reported their child required adaptations or had special needs, predominantly walking aids and bladder control.
